reading: The sketch lays out a usage analytics dashboard: a dark navy sidebar nav (Pulse brand + Usage/Retention/Funnels/Users/Settings, Usage active), a "Usage by hour" heading, a row of filter buttons, a large heatmap card of active sessions by weekday/hour, a "Peak hour" stat card, and a data table of feature usage stats — all content specified verbatim via typed notes.
